source: RFC 0009 §11.3; docs/roadmap.md §9 as of commit 8b881ed3 (the starter serves the refresh route)
statement: When cosec.authentication.login.logout.path is set, the starter serves POST on it as it serves the refresh route (IDN-23): the pair in the body, TokenRevoker.revoke of the pair, whether or not the access token has expired. It answers 204 when the session is ended, and when it already was (token-revoked), so a logout whose answer was lost can be sent again; 401 for a pair that is not one; 503 when the store cannot record it; 500 for any other error; 400 for a body that is not the pair; Cache-Control: no-store on every answer.
guards: jwt:LoginRoutesTest#a logout ends the session, and a logout of an ended session is done too
jwt:LoginRoutesTest#a logout of a pair that is not one is 401, of a body that is not a pair 400, of a store that is down 503
spring-boot:ServedLoginRoutesTest#a logout ends the session, and a logout of an ended one is done too
jwt:ClientContractTest#the served logout route answers as the contract says
